primary.title: Hindustan Copper: Strong metal cycle aids earnings growth, but valuation is not cheap
primary.summary: Hindustan Copper is benefiting from surging copper prices and rising demand, with expansion plans set to boost growth. But after a 130% rally in a year, rich valuations leave little room for disappointment.
